analogue: Gas-phase radical accretion following toluene OH oxidation, including oxygenated C7 peroxy radicals and C14 dimeric products.
citation: Oxygenated organic molecules produced by low-NOx photooxidation of aromatic compounds: contributions to secondary organic aerosol and steric hindrance
evidence: Gas-phase CIMS detected rapidly forming dimer signals tracking aromatic peroxy radicals. Dimer formulas were consistent with both RO₂ self- and cross-reactions.
difference: The experiments used aromatic hydrocarbon parents under low NOx. They did not establish an o-cresol radical-pair identity, complete retention after condensation or the fitted lumped rate in Manchester.
